t: Beginning at the point of intersection of the northeasterly line of Campbell Avenue with the southeasterly line of Rutland Street (formerly Beta Street)…

Extensions of Time — Hennessey is hereby granted an extension of ninety days' time from and after October 5, 1925, within which to complete contract for the completion of the improvement of Tucker avenue.
Director of Traffic Captain Daniel W. Kiely told the Board that the Police Department had no objection to the proposed reduction.
Absent: Supervisors Blake, Casey, Dobbs, Halley — 4.
